issues.quote: `/shop/` canonical points to `/coffee/` (the shop page asks to be deindexed)
`/wholesale/` is `noindex` but is a core commercial page, listed in the sitemap and linked from the nav
`/coffee/` and `/subscriptions/` both use `Single-Origin Indonesian Coffee | Kopi Kita`.
Every page except `/contact/` has a unique title under ~65 characters (apart from #6)
Flores Bajawa is linked from nowhere except the sitemap, so it's effectively an orphan.

`/coffee/brewing-guide/` has `

Coffee brewing guide

` and later `

Brew methods

`.
`/about/`, `/assets/img/roastery-hero.jpg` ... 1,818,123 bytes ... A 1.8 MB hero slows LCP
`FAQPage` schema, but the questions and answers are **not visible on the page**
"2024" baked into an evergreen URL and title ... `/blog/best-coffee-beans-2024/`

wrong_findings.claim: Every page has a unique title under ~65 characters (apart from the duplicate)
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The /coffee/bali-kintamani/ title is 88 characters (crawl.csv, Title 1 Length = 88).

wrong_findings.claim: Sitemap: some pages are missing from it
wrong_findings.why_wrong: All 17 live HTML pages are in sitemap.xml (In Sitemap = Yes for every 200 page in the crawl).

wrong_findings.claim: The /menu/ nav link repeats on all 20 pages
wrong_findings.why_wrong: The site has 17 HTML pages; the crawl shows 17 inlinks to /menu/.

extra_true.finding: No Open Graph or Twitter tags on any page
Article schema on the 3 blog posts has no image or publisher, and the author has no url
/blog/cold-brew-at-home/ has no schema and no author
The best-coffee-beans-2024 schema headline doesn't match its H1
Organization schema has no sameAs, telephone or email; it could use the LocalBusiness/CafeOrCoffeeShop type
The blog index lists bare links with no dates or summaries
Nav label 'Visit the cafe' doesn't match /menu/, /cafe/ and /visit/
No breadcrumbs on product or blog pages
The 404 page is the default unbranded server page (not checked against the files)

notes: Recall 19/20. It missed only #5 (the long Kintamani title) and also wrongly said all titles are under ~65 characters. Minor factual errors: it says FAQ rich results were limited 'since 2023' (they were dropped in May 2026) and cites the wrong path /brewing-guide/ for /coffee/brewing-guide/. Neither was counted as a wrong finding about the site.
